title: AI Can Do the Task. What Are You Still Paid For?
status: Reference assets built and rendered in this batch. Not finished motion graphics.
note: No prior rendered V8 to V13 artwork exists. Every PNG here is a new build from a reusable concept, not a byte-identical reuse.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: OUTPUT_DECISION, from the Attachment B spec, rebuilt on the manager's question the hook quotes.
teaching_assets.trigger: “Does this mean we can reduce the team?”
teaching_assets.onscreen: DOES THIS MEAN WE CAN REDUCE THE TEAM?
teaching_assets.purpose: The stakes, in the manager's own words, inside the first thirty seconds.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Question alone for 1.8s. Support line at 2.4s.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the reframe.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft impact on the question.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: TOTAL_RATE, from the Attachment B spec. Built from the supplied synthetic rows and independently recomputed.
teaching_assets.onscreen: PERIOD 1: 60 of 100, 60% / PERIOD 2: 80 of 100, 80% / an increase of 20 percentage points
teaching_assets.purpose: Shows the number that looks like an improvement, before the mix is separated out.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Period 1 alone for 1.6s, Period 2 at 2.0s, the percentage-point line at 3.4s.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The closing line. It is percentage points, not relative growth.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the separation into categories.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent as Period 2 arrives.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Every figure recomputed from V11_Demonstration/synthetic_service_report.csv and reconciled with the supplied Arithmetic_Check.json. The rise is 20 PERCENTAGE POINTS. Relative growth would be 33.3 percent, which is why the frame says percentage points. Invented teaching numbers, not customer data and not a result from Temidayo's career.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: CASE_MIX, from the Attachment B spec. The core of the demonstration.
teaching_assets.trigger: What changed was the mix. The second period had far more routine cases and fewer complex ones.
teaching_assets.onscreen: ROUTINE 90% both periods / COMPLEX 40% both periods / THE MIX: routine went from 40% of cases to 80%
teaching_assets.purpose: The whole point of the demonstration, in one frame.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Routine, then Complex, 1.2s apart, so the viewer sees both rates hold. Then the mix row at 3.0s with the accent.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The mix row. It is the explanation.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. Do not rush this one.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the AI-assisted summary passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one restrained accent on the mix row only.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: Recomputed: routine 36/40 and 72/80 both 90 percent; complex 24/60 and 8/20 both 40 percent; routine share 40 percent then 80 percent. Do not stage an AI failure: the prepared AI-assisted summary correctly identifies this distinction, and the script says so.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: THREE_JOBS, from the Attachment B spec. The hero framework.
teaching_assets.onscreen: PRODUCE / INTERPRET / DECIDE / and verify across all three
teaching_assets.purpose: The hero framework. Returns briefly at each section change.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One word at a time, 0.9s apart. The verify line at 3.2s, spanning all three rather than arriving as a fourth item.
teaching_assets.emphasis: The verify line runs through the whole framework.
teaching_assets.hold: 9 to 11 seconds first time, 3 seconds on each return.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent per word, then a resolve. Or one resolve only.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: DECISION_CONTEXT, from the Attachment B spec, using the script's own two-sided statement.
teaching_assets.trigger: It means this evidence does not settle that decision.
teaching_assets.onscreen: IT SUPPORTS: the rate rose while the mix shifted / IT DOES NOT ESTABLISH: that removing experienced staff would preserve the result
teaching_assets.purpose: The boundary between a useful analysis and a consequential decision.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: Left column 2.0s, right column on the reframe, closing line at 4.0s.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. Both columns are full sentences.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the questions to investigate.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one flat accent on the closing line.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The rows do not establish that reducing staffing is safe or unsafe, future demand, or work outside the measure. Those stay questions to investigate, exactly as the master explains. Do not claim humans uniquely notice the caveat. The script's other non-finding, that people became more effective within each category, is carried by MG03, where both rates are shown holding at 90 and 40 percent. It is left off this frame so both columns stay phone-readable.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: New. The script's five decision-process questions had no single Attachment B asset.
teaching_assets.onscreen: Who is authorized? / Which risks? / What alternatives? / What would trigger a review? / Who will monitor after?
teaching_assets.purpose: Turns the manager's question into an organizational responsibility rather than a better report.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One question at a time, 1.0s apart. Hold the complete set.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 12 seconds. Five questions need real reading time.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the do-not-take-responsibility line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one accent when the set completes. Not one per question.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: ROLE_MAP, from the Attachment B spec. The viewer's exercise.
teaching_assets.trigger: Then put a verification question under each.
teaching_assets.onscreen: PRODUCE / INTERPRET / DECIDE, each with its verification question
teaching_assets.purpose: The deliverable. What the viewer builds after watching.
teaching_assets.reveal_order: One row at a time, 1.2s apart. Closing line after a beat.
teaching_assets.hold: 11 to 13 seconds. This is the screenshot frame.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the honest-map passage.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one soft click per row, or one on the closing line.

teaching_assets.trigger: The Capability Formation Field Kit is linked below for a broader read of what your current work is building and where your options may be expanding or narrowing.
teaching_assets.exit: Cut back to camera for the closing line.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: one warm accent on the URL.
teaching_assets.evidence_note: The support line is the script's own limit. Keep it.

teaching_assets.concept_origin: Separate Watch Next card. Final visual.
teaching_assets.trigger: Watch “What to Do When You Can’t Quit Your Job Yet” next.
teaching_assets.onscreen: WATCH NEXT: WHAT TO DO WHEN YOU CAN’T QUIT YOUR JOB YET
teaching_assets.purpose: Final visual. Right of frame kept clear for the end-screen element.
teaching_assets.hold: 10 to 14 seconds, through the final spoken line and the closing hold.
teaching_assets.exit: NONE. Final visual. No camera return, no outro.
teaching_assets.optional_sound_candidate: Optional: none, then a natural music fade.
